svg.title: Seven gradient geometries
svg.desc: Illustrative swatches show linear, circular radial, elliptical radial, angular sweep, offset two-circle conical, diamond Manhattan-distance, and square maximum-distance gradients. Every kind supports explicit stops and spread modes.

g.text: Reuse stops. Change the geometry. Assign directly to Color properties.
Pad extends endpoints; Repeat restarts; Reflect reverses; Decal becomes transparent.
